{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] technology|[[Photoreceptor (Hyperspace)|Photoreceptor]], the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] fan club feature}}
{{Quote|"Agonized Exclamation: Ah, my photoreceptors! My photoreceptors!"|An [[HK-50 series assassin droid]], tortured by [[HK-47]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
[[File:3PO_Photoreceptors.png|thumb|right|200px|C-3PO's photoreceptors]]
'''Photoreceptors''', sometimes known as '''optical sensors''', '''optic visors''', '''visual sensors''', '''lenses''', or simply '''optics''', were the visual "organs" of most [[Droid/Legends|droids]], also used by many [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]].

They were often sensitive to a wider visual spectrum than a typical humanoid [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. Droids could have many photoreceptors on their bodies, sometimes highly specialized.

Some droids seemed unable to see with only one photoreceptor activated; this happened to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

[[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] featured an infrared photoreceptor.<ref name="FF43">{{FactFile|43|YAV 9-10|The Battle of Yavin}}</ref>

==Design==
The photoreceptors of droids were often made to resemble the eyes of species with which the droids would interact. The [[LOM-series protocol droid/Legends|LOM-series protocol droid's]] photoreceptors were made to look familiar to insectoid species such as the [[Brizzit]]s, [[Verpine/Legends|Verpines]], [[Gand/Legends|Gand]], [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]] and [[Xi'Dec/Legends|Xi'Dec]],<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> while the [[CZ-series secretary/comm droid|CZ-series communications/business droid]] had optical sensors resembling the eyes of the [[Stacchati/Legends|Stacchati]].<ref name="SWVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
